note: Mutation-battery regression fixture for vts-mutation-guard.mjs --verify. NOT a per-game VTS baseline; it records the judged before/after on each known gaming attack's rule axis so the guard can assert the score responded in the RIGHT axis (the anti-Goodhart regression test). Each entry mirrors the guard's documented intent: an attack must be penalized (drop) or must not gain (denyGain) on its rule axis.
